word-family-reunification.r: Jiātíng tuánjù ràng fūqī kěyǐ zhù zài yīqǐ.

word-family-reunification.t: 他申请{家庭团聚}，想把妻子接来。
word-family-reunification.r: Tā shēnqǐng jiātíng tuánjù, xiǎng bǎ qīzi jiē lái.

word-family-reunification.t: {家庭团聚}的手续可能要一年。
word-family-reunification.r: Jiātíng tuánjù de shǒuxù kěnéng yào yī nián.

word-hukou-cn.r: Tā xiǎng bǎ hùkǒu qiān dào Shànghǎi.

word-accommodation-registration-cn.t: 外国人入住酒店要办{住宿登记}。
word-accommodation-registration-cn.r: Wàiguórén rùzhù jiǔdiàn yào bàn zhùsù dēngjì.

word-accommodation-registration-cn.t: 酒店已经帮我做了{住宿登记}。
word-accommodation-registration-cn.r: Jiǔdiàn yǐjīng bāng wǒ zuò le zhùsù dēngjì.

word-accommodation-registration-cn.t: 你到后二十四小时内要去派出所办{住宿登记}。
word-accommodation-registration-cn.r: Nǐ dào hòu èrshísì xiǎoshí nèi yào qù pàichūsuǒ bàn zhùsù dēngjì.
